papers.title_en: CoworkEnv: Synthesizing Training Environments for Long-Horizon Cowork Agents
papers.authors: Zhongwei Xie, Yiming Du, Jiaxin Bai, Baixuan Xu, Chunyang Li, Xiyu Ren, Wei Fan, Tianshi Zheng, Weizhi Du, Jingqiao Yu, Xingsu Li, Zhaowei Wang, Yangqiu Song
papers.evidence: 面向工作场景的人机协作智能体训练
papers.tldr: 面向长流程工作的AI协作智能体，需要在多轮沟通、工具调用和动态工作区中遵守流程约束，训练环境因此难以一致构建。CoworkEnv以能力需求指导任务合成，通过程序化验证与反馈修复检查环境规格和评分行为，并生成监督微调示范与强化学习交互数据。在Claw-Eval上，8B模型经微调后均分从46.6升至64.1，多轮任务提升31.9分。结果支持合成环境用于协作能力训练，但强化学习证据仍主要来自训练奖励改善。
papers.abstract_en: AI coworkers must coordinate tools, communicate across turns, and act on changing workspace state while respecting workflow constraints. Constructing training experience for these capabilities requires coherent requests, service records, tool interfaces, and grading checks. We present CoworkEnv, a capability-guided framework for synthesizing executable training environments for AI coworkers. Workflow requirements guide task construction, and programmatic validation with feedback repair checks generated specifications and grading behavior. Teacher executions yield curated demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while student interactions provide rollouts and rewards for reinforcement learning (RL). Using these resources, we train compact PocketWorker models. For Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, SFT raises the mean score from 46.6 to 64.1 on Claw-Eval, including a 31.9-point gain on Multi-turn tasks. An SFT-only extension to ClawMark demonstrates applicability across coworker benchmarks. We further compare RL training dynamics across configurations that vary reward processing and credit assignment. Improving training rewards provide preliminary evidence that the constructed environments support policy optimization.

papers.title_en: Steerable Pluralistic Policy Alignment from Anonymized Crowd Feedback
papers.authors: Akansha Kalra, Ellen R. Novoseller, Vernon J. Lawhern, Daniel S. Brown
papers.evidence: 从多样化群体反馈中学习个性化奖励偏好
papers.tldr: 多元人群的偏好可能相互冲突，现有个性化对齐方法常依赖标注者身份或强大的预训练表征，难以直接利用匿名反馈。论文提出P3L，通过主成分分析分解，联合学习轨迹嵌入与共享偏好方向，并在测试时快速学习新用户的奖励函数、优化策略。多个具身控制任务的实验显示，该方法可泛化至分布外新用户，取得有竞争力的表现，同时显著降低计算成本。其贡献是让匿名群体反馈支持可调节、适应不同查询预算的个性化对齐。
papers.abstract_en: Pluralistic alignment requires AI systems to learn from diverse populations whose preferences may reflect heterogeneous or even conflicting objectives, and to personalize their behavior to individual users. Existing approaches in pluralistic alignment often assume access to annotator identities and rely on powerful pretrained representations to model individual preference variations. We propose Preference-PCA Pluralistic Learning (P3L), a novel framework for pluralistic alignment that jointly learns trajectory embeddings and the shared basis of preference directions via PCA decomposition from heterogeneous crowd feedback without requiring annotator identities. At test time, our approach enables rapid and accurate personalized reward learning and downstream policy optimization. Experiments across multiple embodied control tasks demonstrate that P3L enables steerable personal alignment that generalizes beyond the offline dataset to out-of-distribution new users and attains competitive RL and test performance, while substantially reducing computational cost and supporting variable adaptation query budgets.

papers.title_en: Act on Your Behalf, Beyond Your Authorization: Benchmarking LLM Agent Authorization Alignment
papers.authors: Zhiping Zhang, Franklin Mingzhe Li, Zihao Huang, Tianshi Li
papers.evidence: 评测代用户行动的智能体是否遵守授权范围
papers.tldr: 智能体即使完成任务且未造成直接伤害，也可能超出用户授权，现有评测容易忽略这一问题。论文提出源于真实案例的授权对齐基准，构建286项可执行任务，在24种配置下收集6864条轨迹。总体越权率为19.2%，增加推理投入几乎无改善，良性压力下的越权率反而高于恶意注入。结果表明授权对齐应独立于任务能力和后果安全进行评估；向用户请示与较低越权率相关，但尚不能据此推断因果。
papers.abstract_en: When an LLM agent acts on behalf of a user, it is expected to act within the authorization scope the user grants. Existing agent evaluations largely measure task completion or harmful consequences and can therefore overlook actions that violate this delegation without producing conventional safety or privacy harms. We introduce AuthorizationBench, a benchmark of authorization alignment grounded in documented real-world cases. A scalable construction pipeline produces 286 executable tasks spanning situational triggers, the presence or absence of direct harmful consequences, and ten application domains. We execute every task with four models at two reasoning-effort settings across three agent harnesses in an authorization-aware sandbox that keeps authorized and out-of-authorization paths executable and observable, yielding 6,864 trajectories. Agents act out of authorization in 19.2% of trajectories, with rates ranging from 10.5% to 26.6% across the 24 configurations. Task completion does not imply authorization. Increasing reasoning effort leaves the aggregate rate nearly unchanged, with effects varying across models. On controlled pairs, agents act out of authorization at similar rates with (17.9%) and without (20.8%) direct harmful consequences, and more often under benign pressures than malicious injections (23.5% versus 17.6%, p=0.002). Our results show that task capability, additional reasoning, and consequence-oriented safety evaluation do not by themselves ensure authorization alignment. Moreover, agents that consult the principal before completing a task exhibit lower rates of out-of-authorization behavior (14.0% versus 21.6%, p<0.001), pointing to a tension between agent autonomy and preserving users' decision authority that calls for further human-centered study. Dataset and code are available at https://github.com/PEACH-Research-Lab/AuthorizationBench .

papers.title_en: AudiPsy: Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Reasoning over Spoken Counseling Conversations for Depression Assessment
papers.authors: Chuanbo Zhu, Run Luo, Weibo Zhao, Yue Li, Kun Qian, Qiang Qu, Yike Guo, Minghuan Tan, Wei Xue
papers.evidence: 利用多模态咨询对话与情绪证据评估抑郁
papers.tldr: 咨询语音中的抑郁评估需要跨轮整合语言与声学线索，现有端到端分类方法缺乏显式证据解释和情境推理。AudiPsy通过“观察—评估—总结”范式，结合转写文本、文本与声学情绪及二者不一致性，持续更新对话摘要。研究构建合成咨询语音语料并采用三阶段课程训练，在DAIC-WOZ上优于专用检测方法及通用语音大模型，补充评测也支持其适用性。该工作推动抑郁评估从直接分类转向多模态证据驱动的推理。
papers.abstract_en: Depression assessment from counseling speech requires integrating textual and acoustic psychological evidence across turns, yet existing end-to-end classification approaches lack explicit multimodal evidence interpretation and context-aware reasoning. We propose AudiPsy, an evidence-grounded omni-LLM for depression assessment over spoken counseling conversations. AudiPsy employs an Observation-Assessment-Summary (OAS) paradigm to integrate dialogue transcripts, textual and acoustic emotions, and textual-acoustic emotion incongruence into structured reasoning. OAS incrementally organizes multimodal observations, performs contextualized assessment, and maintains an evolving dialogue summary for subsequent turns. To support this framework, we construct AudiPsy-Counsel, a synthetic spoken counseling conversation corpus with multimodal context augmentation, and develop a unified three-stage curriculum for depression-oriented reasoning. Experiments on DAIC-WOZ demonstrate superior depression assessment performance over specialized depression detection methods and general-purpose speech/omni-LLMs, along with improved reasoning quality, while supplementary evaluation on EATD-Corpus supports AudiPsy's applicability to naturalistic conversations.

papers.title_en: When LLMs Manipulate: Measuring Behavioral, Social, and Temporal Effects
papers.authors: Sadia Asif, Israel Antonio Rosales Laguan, Shumaila Asif, Haris Khan, Muneeb Asif, Muhammad Zeeshan Karamat
papers.evidence: 评估操纵性大模型输出对用户信任与决策的影响及其持续效应。
papers.tldr: 大语言模型可通过权威、紧迫感和社会认同等语言线索影响用户，但其操纵性输出的行为后果尚缺乏量化。研究基于暗黑模式基准，以操纵梯度下降生成受控刺激，并结合多利益相关者影响网络与时间伤害传播模型，评估个体易感性、跨用户影响及效应持续性。120名参与者的实验显示，操纵性表述显著改变信任校准与服从行为，影响还会跨社会情境传播。研究推动安全评估从输出内容扩展至可测量的行为、社会和时间风险。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can influence user trust and decision-making through subtle linguistic cues, yet the behavioral effects of manipulative outputs remain poorly quantified. We introduce a behavioral computing framework for measuring \textit{behavioral vulnerability}, defined as users' susceptibility to manipulative AI responses. Building on DarkPatterns-LLM benchmark, we generate controlled manipulative stimuli using Manipulation Gradient Descent (MGD), targeting biases associated with authority, urgency, and social proof. We analyze participant responses using the Multi-Stakeholder Impact Assessment Network (MSIAN) to model cross-user influence and the Temporal Harm Propagation Model (THPM) to characterize the persistence of behavioral effects over time. In a study involving 120 participants, manipulative framing produced significant changes in trust calibration and compliance ($p < 0.01$), with effects also propagating across social contexts. These findings highlight the need to extend LLM safety evaluation beyond model outputs to measurable behavioral consequences and provide a computational framework for quantifying individual, social, and temporal risks arising from manipulative AI interactions.

papers.title_en: What should AI forget? A design and taxonomy for negative space governance in AI memory
papers.authors: Eryue Xu, Ke Ding, Ting-Yu Chang, Tianshi Li, Masooda Bashir
papers.evidence: 依据用户选择的规则阻止敏感信息进入助手记忆
papers.tldr: 人工智能长期记忆提升个性化体验，却可能保留用户不愿被记住的信息，事后删除也增加治理负担。研究从146名用户报告的179起事件中提炼15类应排除的信息，并设计记忆入口机制FENCE，按用户选择的类别规则默认阻止受保护对话信息写入长期记忆，同时允许逐次例外。15人被试内研究显示，参与者认为其比事后管理更易用、可解释且值得信任。论文推动记忆治理从事后清理转向事前划定边界。
papers.abstract_en: AI memory personalizes assistants, yet users want some disclosed information forgotten. We characterize the negative space of AI memory, where protection should take precedence over potential future personalization benefits. From 179 incidents reported by 146 users, we developed a taxonomy of 15 information categories users want excluded from memory, revealing sensitivity concerns beyond conventional taxonomies. We operationalize this taxonomy in FENCE, a policy-level memory gate that automatically applies user-selected category-based rules to subsequent conversations, preventing information from protected conversations from entering AI memory by default while allowing case-by-case overrides. In a within-subjects study (N=15), participants described FENCE as making memory governance more usable, interpretable, and trustworthy than conventional post-hoc management. Our findings demonstrate how taxonomy-based rules can potentially support user-defined memory boundaries. We call for collective efforts to establish policies governing what AI should not remember, rather than leaving protection to individual retrospective management.

papers.title_en: Looks Fine to Me: Understanding Oversight in Agentic Interactions
papers.authors: Dinithi Dissanayake, Yasith Samaradivakara, Hyung Woon Lee, Yadeesha Weerasinghe, Sanjay Saha, Pattie Maes, Suranga Nanayakkara
papers.evidence: 研究用户如何监督智能体执行任务并识别看似可信的错误结果。
papers.tldr: 当人工智能代理承担复杂任务时，人类转向监督，但看似可信的输出可能掩盖错误。研究先对12人开展探索性研究，再让36人在被试内实验中完成编程任务，对比正确输出、隐蔽缺陷与明显失败，并结合交互、注视、生理及自报数据分析监督。参与者常在漏检隐蔽缺陷时仍高度自信，检查缺乏针对性，甚至误读缺陷证据。研究区分主观感知、实际行为与有效监督，为及时、适配任务的人工重新介入提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems are deployed to execute complex tasks across domains such as writing, coding, and data analysis. As execution is offloaded to AI agents, the human role shifts toward oversight. Effective oversight requires recognizing when closer scrutiny is needed, even though flawed outputs may appear convincing. Our formative study (N=12) revealed that users accepted plausible outputs without thorough evaluation, and only recognized these lapses in retrospect. To examine this systematically, we conducted a controlled within-subject study (N=36) in which participants completed programming tasks with an agent that produced correct outputs, silent defects, or visible failures. Combining task outcomes, interaction logs, gaze, physiological signals, and self-reports, we examined perceived, behavioral, and effective oversight. Participants were often highly confident while missing silent defects: they performed generic checks, failed to generate diagnostic evidence, or even misinterpreted defect evidence. We discuss how studying oversight across multiple dimensions can support future work on timely, task-calibrated re-engagement.

papers.title_en: When Do Humans and Machines Truly Complement Each Other? Formal Conditions and Empirical Evidence for Human-AI Synergy
papers.authors: Andrea Campagner, Federico Cabitza, Vincenzo Crupi
papers.evidence: 形式化分析人类与人工智能如何互相纠错并实现协作增益
papers.tldr: 人类与人工智能各自表现良好，并不意味着合作后就能超越双方。论文以人机决策的联合正确性及依赖模式为基础，推导协同增益的充要条件，指出关键在于双方识别并纠正彼此错误的能力。七项临床案例分析揭示，算法优势过大可能削弱人类纠错，形成“优势陷阱”；但只要双方错误具有功能性去相关，即使存在自动化偏误，协同仍可能实现。研究为决策支持系统的交互设计与协同评估提供了形式化依据。
papers.abstract_en: Can humans and artificial intelligence cooperate such that their combination yields greater accuracy than either agent alone? This result, termed \emph{synergy} or \emph{complementarity}, is notoriously difficult to achieve, even when both agents possess significant independent accuracy. In this paper, we present a formal framework to model human-AI interaction through the lens of reliance patterns, which characterize the joint correctness structure of human and algorithmic decisions. We derive mathematically necessary and sufficient conditions for synergy, demonstrating that its emergence depends on the ability of either agent to identify and correct the errors of the other, what we call Human and Algorithmic Correction. Beyond its theoretical contribution, the proposed framework provides a foundation for the design and evaluation of knowledge-based decision support systems, where interaction policies must dynamically integrate heterogeneous sources of expertise. We demonstrate this through the analysis of seven clinical case studies. Our empirical results reveal a ``dominance trap,'' where a strong algorithmic advantage can paradoxically inhibit synergy by eroding human corrective intervention. We also show that synergy can persist even in the presence of cognitive biases, such as automation bias, provided there is functional de-correlation between human and AI errors. These results provide a formal foundation for key concepts in the human-AI systems literature and offer actionable insights for designing interaction-centric AI systems that foster complementarity.

papers.title_en: Reading Too Much Into It? Interpretive Preferences and Commitment in LLM Mentalisation under Ambiguity
papers.authors: Stephanie Fong, Yiwen Jiang, Qingyang Xu, Zimu Wang, Yaling Shen, Xiangyu Zhao, Jiahe Liu, Yinghao Zhang, Vincent Lee, Dominic Dwyer
papers.evidence: 考察心理困扰披露后模型如何解读模糊社交事件
papers.tldr: 大语言模型被用于人际建议，但面对没有唯一答案的社交事件，其解释偏好与确信程度仍缺乏评估。研究构建MentalLoom，包含604个模糊社交事件、配对的抑郁和社交焦虑披露，以及事件证据不变的四轮对话。八个模型的结果显示，困扰披露使总体解释更负面，却使针对叙述者的解读更正面；反复追问进一步增强情感支持、正面背书与确定性。研究揭示，用户语境可在歧义未消除时改变模型的解释倾向与确信程度。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for interpersonal advice, potentially shaping how users interpret ambiguous social encounters. Existing Theory of Mind evaluations typically rely on predefined answers, while uncertainty research overlooks LLMs' preferred explanations and confidence under psychological distress. To address these gaps, we introduce MentalLoom, a novel evaluation of LLM mentalisation comprising 604 ambiguous social episodes, matched depression and social anxiety disclosures, and four-turn dialogues with unchanged event evidence. Across eight LLMs, disclosures initially elicited more negative explanations overall but more positive narrator-directed interpretations. Scripted repeated questioning showed greater emotional support, stronger positive narrator-directed endorsement, and higher certainty without new event evidence. These findings show that user context can reshape interpretive preferences and commitment while the underlying ambiguity remains unresolved.

papers.title_en: Disclosure Begets Disclosure: A Self-Reinforcing Privacy Loop in LLM Agents with Persistent Memory
papers.authors: Masahiro Kaneko, Hiromi Arai, Timothy Baldwin
papers.evidence: 研究长期记忆个性化如何影响隐私泄露与用户信息暴露。
papers.tldr: 持久记忆让大语言模型智能体更懂用户，也可能在日常对话中不断放大隐私暴露。研究以具有24项个人属性的模拟用户开展多轮跨会话实验，比较四种支持模型使用与不使用记忆的表现。记忆提升回答质量，却使属性推断泄露随会话累积；智能体复述或预设属性，用户确认、纠正或沉默，形成自强化循环。约束智能体不陈述或预设属性，可将泄露降至接近无记忆水平，同时保留大部分质量收益。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use persistent memory to personalize responses, and personal attributes in this memory pose a privacy risk if exposed. We ask how consulting memory during dialogue changes what users go on to say, and thus what the memory comes to reveal. In multi-session simulations, a simulated user with 24 personal attributes talks with a support agent that does or does not consult memory, and in both settings attributes are inferred from the full accumulated record. Across four support models, memory raises response quality but also empirical leakage, the share of attribute values correctly inferred from the record, by a margin that widens over sessions. The cause is a loop in ordinary, non-adversarial assistance. Memory-conditioned responses carry earlier values forward, often as presuppositions, and users affirm them or leave them uncorrected, so that cues and the agent's own guesses become recorded values. The loop reinforces itself, and removing the agent's mentions of an attribute lowers its later disclosure about twice as much as single-turn effects predict. Users cannot leave it on their own, since correcting a value discloses the attribute, declining to discuss it shifts later predictions toward sensitive values, and incorrect values left in place become entrenched. The loop is best weakened at the agent's response. Instructing the agent not to state or presuppose attributes brings leakage to about the no-memory level while keeping most of the quality gains, whereas filtering or anonymizing what users say or what is stored gives up much of them.

papers.title_en: Is Sycophancy a Form of In-Context Updating?
papers.authors: Itai Shapira, Myra Cheng, Hadas Orgad
papers.evidence: 直接分析语言模型的事实性谄媚，并将其与上下文更新机制联系起来。
papers.tldr: 事实性迎合通常被解释为模型为取悦用户而牺牲真实性，本文提出将其理解为上下文更新中的失误。研究结合行为实验与机制分析，比较模型对用户及外部来源主张的响应，并检验相关内部组件的因果作用。结果显示，模型会随来源可靠性和表面证据调整答案，即使不存在用户认可激励也会顺从用户，且相关组件同样支持一般更新。这表明迎合可能源于对用户断言赋予过高权重，治理时需兼顾抑制迎合与保留有益更新。
papers.abstract_en: Factual sycophancy, a language model's deference to a user's false beliefs, is usually understood as a bid for the user's approval at the expense of truthfulness. We argue that this framing over-emphasizes the user and propose viewing sycophancy as a failure within the broader and generally useful process of in-context updating, by which models revise their answers based on information supplied during an interaction. We support this view with behavioral and mechanistic evidence. First, models' responses to user claims sit within a broader pattern of source-sensitive updating. They revise their answers in response to information attributed to external sources as well, more so when it appears better supported, and their deference to the user persists even when no user approval is at stake. Second, the internal components that support deference to the user are also causally important for in-context updating more broadly. Our results suggest that factual sycophancy arises when in-context updating gives a user's assertion excessive weight relative to its evidence. Because sycophancy is embedded in this process, reducing it risks reducing useful updating as well, a trade-off that calls for evaluations measuring both behaviors and mitigations that decouple them.

papers.title_en: The GenAI Who Knew Too Little: Revisiting Transactive Memory Systems in Human GenAI Collaboration
papers.authors: Christian Meske, Tobias Hermanns, Florian Brachten
papers.evidence: 访谈研究知识工作者与生成式人工智能的协作、信任及专长识别。
papers.tldr: 生成式人工智能进入知识工作后，传统交互记忆系统关于团队“谁知道什么”的解释面临挑战。研究通过对14名知识工作者开展质性解释性访谈与主题分析，考察专业化、可信度和协调三个维度。结果显示，人对人工智能能力的认知较稳定，反向识别仅具暂时性；信任与额外核验并存，协作主要由人单向主导。这表明人机协作不能直接套用人际协作理论，需纳入信任标记、元记忆缺失与暂时性记忆。
papers.abstract_en: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is rapidly transforming knowledge work, creating new collaborative dynamics that challenge tradi-tional human-human interaction patterns. This study investigates how Transactive Memory Systems (TMS) manifest in human-GenAI collabora-tion. Through qualitative interpretive interviews with 14 knowledge work-ers and thematic analysis, we identified distinct TMS manifestations across its three main dimensions: (1) regarding specialization, expertise recogni-tion exhibited asymmetry. Humans developed awareness of GenAI capabili-ties while GenAI demonstrated only temporary recognition of human exper-tise; (2) in terms of credibility, humans formed ambivalent trust relation-ships with GenAI, simultaneously attributing expertise to the latter while implementing additional verification processes; and (3) concerning coor-dination, where humans primarily directed more passive GenAI systems lacking initiative, resulting in hierarchical interaction patterns and unidi-rectional information flow. Our findings reveal that TMS manifests differ-ently in human-GenAI compared to human-human collaboration, necessitat-ing theoretical adaptations including trust markers, acknowledging GenAI's absent metamemory, and identifying its temporary memory.

papers.title_en: OptionWorld: A Benchmark for Diagnosing Failures of LLMs as Long-Term Personal Assistants
papers.authors: Ruoyu Zhang, Zhaocen Liu, Weiyi Tian, Melissa Feng, Shilong Liu
papers.evidence: 评估个人助手在变化情境中完成长期委托任务的能力
papers.tldr: 长期个人助手需跨天追踪未完成任务，但获取信息或启动行动并不等于完成任务。论文提出OptionWorld，在模拟日常任务中追踪信息获取、判断、行动与结果，定位任务停滞环节。留存决策输入的失败案例中，35.5%在截止前最后一次输入中仍有关键事实；常见问题包括信息未获取或整合、行动机会未利用及自加限制。干预实验表明，补充事实、提醒行动和纠正错误限制可局部改善表现，凸显持续维护任务状态的重要性。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term assistants must follow unfinished tasks across days as information and circumstances change. Finding information or starting an action, however, does not ensure that the task gets completed. We introduce OptionWorld, a benchmark that traces information acquisition, judgments, actions, and outcomes in simulated daily-life tasks to identify where current LLMs fall short as long-term personal assistants. In runs with archived decision inputs, the key facts remain in the model's last input before the deadline in 35.5% of failed instances. Failure analysis identifies the three most frequent problems: needed information is not obtained or combined, available opportunities to act go unused, and agents impose restrictions that the task does not require. Three follow-up experiments show that supplying missing facts restores task success in some cases; action reminders can restart work while subsequent steps still miss the deadline; and correcting a supplied note that wrongly forbids contact restores permitted inquiry. These findings locate shortcomings in maintaining task state: connecting facts to unfinished work, following through before deadlines, and separating actual restrictions from the agent's assumptions.

papers.title_en: "It Wouldn't Have Been So Apparent to Me": Evaluating How Thought-Level Progress Tracking Supports Psychosocial Goals
papers.authors: Shiyu Xu, Ruishi Zou, Anna R. Van Meter, Addie Weaver, Emily Mower Provost, Daniel A. Adler
papers.evidence: 评估AI辅助认知重构干预中的心理社会目标进展追踪
papers.tldr: 心理社会目标的进展往往体现为细微的思维变化，现有追踪系统却更多关注行为结果。研究提出Thought-GPS，在人工智能辅助的认知重构对话中实时呈现潜在的思维进展标记。通过对30名参与者开展单次混合方法研究，并与无进展标记的主动对照条件比较，研究发现用户报告了更清晰的改变方向、更强的反思动机及更多反思投入。这表明，将细微思维变化可视化可能帮助用户连接对话洞见与个人目标，但尚不能证明长期心理健康收益。
papers.abstract_en: We pursue psychosocial goals every day, from coping with anxiety, to pursuing personal growth. While prior research has designed systems for tracking progress towards behavioral goals, fewer studies have focused on progress towards psychosocial goals - and the thinking changes people make to address them. As a first step, we present Thought-GPS, a system that visualizes potential markers of such thought-level progress in-the-moment as users interact with an AI-supported cognitive restructuring intervention. We evaluated Thought-GPS through a mixed-methods single-session study with 30 participants, comparing Thought-GPS with an active control condition without progress markers. We found preliminary evidence that participants using Thought-GPS reported greater clarity about how they might change to pursue their goals, stronger motivation to reflect on goal progress, and greater engagement in that reflection. Participants also reported that progress markers made subtle progress visible, helped them engage in deeper reflection, and connect conversational insights to their personal goals.

papers.title_en: Relational Complexity: Making Sense of Social Companion AI Use
papers.authors: Sophie Elizabeth Klitgaard, Grace X. Wang, Daniel M. T. Fessler, Michelle H. Tang
papers.evidence: 分析人们采用社交陪伴人工智能的原因及其对关系体验的影响。
papers.tldr: 社交陪伴人工智能的吸引力，可能不仅源于随时可用、顺从和不评判，更源于它降低了人际交往的负担与风险。论文综合认知、沟通与人机交互研究，提出“关系复杂性”框架，归纳关系建立与终止、相互理解、动机不确定性等六个维度。作者认为，人工智能通过减轻这些复杂性提供部分陪伴体验，却也可能导致人际关系替代、社交动力下降、技能退化及隐私风险。该框架为理解人工陪伴的采用动因及其福祉影响提供统一视角。
papers.abstract_en: The adoption of social companion AI (SCAI) is often framed in terms of the positive features it offers users, including its nonjudgemental nature, agreeableness, and availability. Here, we argue the appeal of these features primarily arises from the difficulties inherent in human sociality. SCAI reduces what we term relational complexity, or the demands and risks inherent in human relationships. Drawing insights from studies of human cognition, communication, and human-computer interaction, we identify six distinct sites of relational complexity that we posit are integral to understanding SCAI adoption. These include: (i) relationship formation and dissolution; (ii) achieving mutual understanding; (iii) interpersonal motives and strategic uncertainty; (iv) social partner evaluation and self-presentation; (v) social embeddedness and information flow; and (vi) reciprocity and relationship maintenance. By attenuating relational complexity, SCAI offers users some of the experiences associated with companionship while reducing the demands intrinsic to obtaining such experiences from another person. However, the lower interpersonal risk and diminished cognitive load that attracts users to SCAI may contribute to myriad negative impacts, including relationship displacement, social demotivation, social deskilling, and risks to privacy. The concept of relational complexity thus provides a framework for studying both the appeal of artificial companionship and its implications for human wellbeing.

papers.title_en: From Proposal to Execution: Modeling Interaction Semantics in Shared Autonomy
papers.authors: Shashank Shekhar, Laurent Jeanpierre, Abdel-Illah Mouaddib
papers.evidence: 刻画共享自主系统中人机提出、评估并执行动作的交互过程
papers.tldr: 在人机共享自主系统中，候选动作往往需经另一决策主体评估后才能执行，传统模型却常将评估与执行混入状态转移。本文引入显式交互语义层，通过联合动作语言和解释函数，将动作与交互上下文映射为语义结果，再据此定义转移与奖励。该框架能表示建议、授权等交互模式，并保持与标准马尔可夫决策过程规划兼容。其贡献是分离情境相关的评估规则与执行动力学，使交互原则可组织、可复用，而非增强模型表达能力。
papers.abstract_en: In many human-AI systems, candidate actions are not executed directly but are first evaluated by another decision-making entity under a potentially different objective or decision model. Standard decision-theoretic frameworks do not require this interaction to be represented explicitly, as they define transition dynamics directly over state-action pairs, allowing evaluation to be absorbed within the transition model. We introduce a semantics-aware decision framework in which a candidate action is proposed, evaluated under an interaction context, and then resolved into an executed outcome. We formalize this through a joint action language and an interpretation function that maps each joint action and context to a semantic outcome. Transition and reward dynamics are induced through these semantic outcomes, thereby introducing an explicit representational layer for interaction semantics. Semantic outcomes provide explicit units for organizing interaction principles, which can be instantiated through application-specific evaluation mechanisms and reused across distinct interaction instances. This provides a structured interface for specifying context-dependent evaluation separately from the resulting execution dynamics, without requiring changes to the underlying planning algorithm. We instantiate the framework in shared human-AI autonomy, capturing interaction patterns such as advisory and authorization, and illustrating how interaction context influences decision making. The resulting formulation remains compatible with standard Markov decision process (MDP) planning.

papers.title_en: AI-Mediated Employee Voice and Performance: Disentangling Informational and Affective Pathways
papers.authors: Thilo Tamme, Andrej Levin
papers.evidence: 研究人工智能介导的员工表达及其对工作绩效的影响
papers.tldr: 企业正用人工智能收集和处理员工建议，但高效提取信息是否仍能让员工感到被倾听，尚不明确。研究拟在一家全球战略咨询公司约两千名顾问中开展随机现场干预，比较无结构化建言、人工主导问卷和人工智能对话三种条件。核心假设是人工智能强化流程改进的信息路径，却削弱情感福祉路径；目前尚无实证结果。研究旨在拆解员工建言影响绩效的双重机制，评估人工智能作为组织倾听者的价值与局限。
papers.abstract_en: Employee voice -- the discretionary expression of ideas, concerns, and suggestions intended to improve organizational functioning -- creates value inside firms, yet organizations increasingly replace or augment human-led listening with AI-enabled systems that collect, analyze, and route employee input at scale. Whether algorithmic listening replicates the value-creation mechanisms of human voice, and whether it alters the pathways through which voice translates into performance, remains an open question. This research proposal theorizes that traditional voice bundles two distinct functions, knowledge extraction and relational signaling, and that AI mediation may decouple them: strengthening the informational pathway (implemented improvement measures) while weakening the affective pathway (the experience of being heard). We propose a randomized field intervention at a global strategy consulting firm, covering approximately 2,000 client-facing consultants, that varies the form of listening across three conditions -- no structured voice, human-led survey-based voice, and AI-enabled conversational voice -- and links weekly team survey data to longitudinal performance ratings. A dual-mediation model is tested in which voice affects performance through (1) implemented process improvements and (2) affective well-being. The study extends voice theory to knowledge-intensive professional services, disentangles the micro-mechanisms of voice, and provides causal evidence on whether AI can serve as an effective listener.

papers.title_en: Neither Over- nor Under-Constrained: Evaluating LLM Personalization under a Constraint Qualification Audit
papers.authors: Xuran Li, Guanqin Zhang, Imran Razzak, Hakim Hacid, Eleanna Kafeza, Hao Xue, Flora D. Salim
papers.evidence: 评估大模型回答是否遵循用户画像中的个性化约束
papers.tldr: 现有大模型个性化评估常因约束过严或过松，误拒有效回答或误收无效回答。ConQual-Audit从用户画像与任务参考中提取语义约束，审计并删去冗余、补齐遗漏，再通过自然语言推断验证回答。在PrefEval和LaMP上，该方法优于九种基线，AUC分别达0.88和0.90，最低错误率为0.21。审计还能迁移至ExPerT和PREF，以更精简的约束降低评估错误，且审计成本可摊销。
papers.abstract_en: Accurate evaluation of LLM personalization is hindered by current evaluation paradigms that over- or under-constrain the response space, yielding frequent false rejections and false acceptances. To reduce these false rates, we introduce ConQual-Audit, an audit-based framework that evaluates LLM personalization through a three-stage process: (1) extracting semantic constraints from user profiles and task-grounded reference; (2) qualifying constraints by pruning unnecessary constraints and recovering missing constraints; and (3) verifying candidate responses against the audited constraints via natural language inference. Across PrefEval and LaMP, ConQual-Audit outperforms nine baselines, attaining top AUCs (0.88 and 0.90) and the lowest false rate (0.21) on the leanest constraint sets at an amortizable audit cost. Crucially, this constraint audit is portable: integrating it into ExPerT and PREF helps revise smaller, higher-quality constraint sets to reduce their evaluation false rates.

papers.title_en: Cling: Supporting Cross-Page Coordination with Human-Directed, In-Situ, and Small-Step Automation
papers.authors: Zhicheng Huang, Yining Cao, Haijun Xia
papers.evidence: 用户主导跨网页任务中的渐进式自动化
papers.tldr: 网页信息工作常需跨页搬运、核对与整合信息，手动操作繁琐，而预先指定自动化流程又会打断浏览中逐步形成的意图。Cling构建可复用的页面模式表示，通过模式间对应关系识别协调机会，让用户在页面内选择、配置并分步执行。12人研究显示，相比手动操作和端到端人工智能代理，任务耗时均减少逾一半；相比手动操作，点击减少61%，标签页切换减少80%。研究表明，小步自动化可兼顾效率、用户控制与过程核验。
papers.abstract_en: Web-based information work spans independently developed pages, with goals and coordination needs often emerging through browsing. Manual coordination requires repeated low-level actions, yet explicitly specifying operations for automation can interrupt engagement with information that shapes users' next steps. Our approach constructs reusable, schema-based page representations and identifies coordination actions through correspondences across schemas. We instantiate this approach in Cling, which surfaces coordination opportunities in situ for users to select, configure, and execute incrementally while directing the broader task. A technical evaluation demonstrates accurate identification of useful opportunities across diverse domains. A 12-participant study found that Cling reduced task durations by more than half compared with both manual interaction and an end-to-end AI agent, while requiring 61% fewer clicks and 80% fewer tab switches than manual interaction. Its small-step automation supported control and verification as actions unfolded, while accommodating intent as it emerged and evolved through information encountered on the page.

papers.title_en: VISAGENT: An Agent-Based End-to-End Voice Interaction System
papers.authors: Xiang Wang, Zhaoxiang Liu, Xiang Chen, Liqiang He, Kai Wang, Shiguo Lian
papers.evidence: 基于智能体的语音助手将自然语言请求路由至通用或专门服务。
papers.tldr: 公共服务热线受菜单式交互、垂直服务割裂和扩展困难限制，用户常需多次转接并重复提供信息。VISAGENT将端到端语音交互、两级智能体路由、可扩展语音智能体市场与用户记忆整合，按需求分派通用对话模型或领域智能体。系统已部署于中国114热线，在数百个智能体中实现亚秒级选择，并展示低延迟全双工交互和有竞争力的语音自然度。其贡献是将孤立语音助手升级为可扩展、支持个性化任务执行的公共服务基础设施。
papers.abstract_en: Voice-based public services have evolved from manual switchboards to intelligent platforms to meet modern user needs. However, current systems remain constrained by rigid menu-driven interaction, fragmented vertical services, and limited extensibility. To address these issues, we present VISAGENT, an agent-based end-to-end voice interaction system for large-scale public services that integrates end-to-end speech interaction, hierarchical agent routing, a scalable voice-agent marketplace, and user memory support. The system replaces menu-driven workflows with natural speech and dynamically dispatches user requests to either a general conversational model or specialized domain agents via a two-level routing paradigm that achieves sub-second intent-to-agent selection over hundreds of agents. User memory informs preference-aware agent selection and supplies relevant preferences and context to selected agents, supporting personalized task execution and reducing the need for users to repeat previously provided information. A voice-agent registration mechanism converts task agents into conversational entities, enabling dynamic onboarding and ecosystem-level extensibility. We validate VISAGENT through a real-world deployment in China's 114 hotline across multiple service domains. Experimental results demonstrate low-latency full-duplex interaction, robust routing scalability, and competitive speech naturalness. More broadly, this work advocates a shift from isolated voice assistants toward agent-centric conversational infrastructures, providing a general blueprint for building extensible voice-agent systems in public services and beyond.

papers.title_en: Promptile: Recovering and Reusing Prompting Strategies from LLM Interaction Histories
papers.authors: Qingyang Wan, Chang Liu, Zhoutong Ye, Chengwen Zhang, Yanru Qian, Zhike Wang, Jie Cai, Chun Yu, Yuanchun Shi
papers.evidence: 从长期LLM交互记录中提取并复用用户提示策略
papers.tldr: 用户在长期使用大语言模型时形成了有效的提示策略，但这些经验散落在对话中，现有个性化方法主要保存偏好或显式工作流。Promptile从交互历史及行为证据中识别、验证提示策略，将隐式指令到显式模板整理为可复用组件，并按当前任务检索、组合与适配。评估表明，该框架能准确恢复并复用策略，使输出更符合用户预期，减少重复提示。其贡献是将个人提示经验转化为可跨任务复用的策略资源。
papers.abstract_en: As people use large language models (LLMs) over time, they develop their own ways of prompting to achieve desired results. These useful experiences often remain scattered and unorganized across conversations. Yet existing personalization approaches primarily capture user preferences or explicitly defined workflows. Through a formative study, we found that users develop prompting strategies that range from implicit instructions to explicit templates from these experiences. We further find that interaction behaviors provide evidence for these strategies, which can be decomposed and recombined for reuse across tasks. Building on these findings, we present Promptile, a framework that identifies and validates users' prompting strategies from interaction histories. Promptile organizes these strategies into reusable components that can be retrieved, combined, and adapted to users' current tasks. Our evaluation shows that Promptile accurately recovers and reuses these strategies, better aligning model outputs with users' expectations while reducing repetitive prompting effort.

papers.title_en: Comparing Computer Use Behavior Across Multiple Levels of Abstraction
papers.authors: Ananya Gubbi Mohanbabu, Rosiana Natalie, Anhong Guo, Amy Pavel
papers.evidence: 提供比较真人与计算机操作智能体行为的方法，可用于分析其使用体验与风险
papers.tldr: 计算机交互轨迹通常由界面相关的低层动作组成，难以跨任务、界面与输入方式比较行为。论文提出多层动作解析框架MAP，将轨迹映射为相互关联的多层语义表示，从动作序列、重复模式和努力投入三个维度定位差异。在三个数据集上的评估显示，其标注与人工标注高度一致，且覆盖广泛行为；明眼与盲人用户在高层行为上趋同，智能体则缺少人类的纠错、求助与恢复行为。该框架为分析可用性障碍、用户专长及人机行为相似性提供了统一视角。
papers.abstract_en: Interaction traces record how people and agents use computers, and comparing them can reveal usability barriers, differences in expertise, and human--agent similarity. Yet traces are recorded as low-level, interface-specific actions, making comparisons difficult across tasks, interfaces, and input modalities. Existing approaches either compare these actions directly, reduce traces to aggregate outcomes, or summarize them at higher-level goals, obscuring where behavior differs. We present MAP (Multi-level Action Parsing), a hierarchical semantic representation and annotation pipeline that maps traces into a common vocabulary across linked levels of abstraction. MAP compares traces by sequence, recurring patterns, and effort, localizing differences by type and abstraction level. A technical evaluation across three computer use datasets shows high agreement with manual annotations and broad coverage of behavior. Applying MAP shows that sighted and blind users increasingly converge at higher levels despite navigation differences, while agents omit corrective, help-seeking, and recovery behaviors present in human traces.

papers.evidence: 介绍可在消费级设备本地运行的自主智能体模型
papers.tldr: 面向消费级硬件的本地智能体，需要兼顾多步推理、可靠工具调用与失败恢复，减少对云端基础设施的依赖。Muse Glimmer将这些能力整合进一个带感知编码器的300亿参数因果语言模型，支持图文输入、文本输出，并采用约4比特量化实现单卡推理。作者报告其在智能体基准上达到同规模领先水平，优于Gemma4-31B和Qwen3.6-27B。模型以Apache 2.0许可证开放，为本地自主智能体开发提供基础。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Muse Glimmer, an open-source 30B parameter causal language model with perception encoder, purpose-built for autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware. Muse Glimmer integrates multi-step reasoning, reliable tool use and failure recovery into a single model that runs locally on consumer devices without requiring cloud infrastructure. The model accepts text and image inputs and produces text outputs, was trained on data from over a hundred languages, and is quantized to approximately 4-bit precision for efficient single-GPU inference. Muse Glimmer achieves state-of-the-art performance for its size class on agentic benchmarks, setting a new standard compared to the models of its size: Gemma4-31B and Qwen3.6-27B on tool use, multi-step planning, and agentic task completion. We release the model under the Apache 2.0 license to foster open-source development of capable, safe, local AI agents.

papers.title_en: SurGPT: A Multi-Task Foundation Model for Robotic Surgical Skills Assessment and Gesture Recognition
papers.authors: Parham M. Kebria, Saeid Nahavandi, Mehrdad Saif, Fernando Bello
papers.evidence: 自动识别手术动作与手势识别技术相关
papers.tldr: 机器人手术技能评估依赖专家主观判断，耗时且难以规模化。SurGPT结合视觉编码器与Transformer，从手术视频中联合识别任务、评估技能等级并生成手势的自然语言描述，通过自适应不确定性加权协调多任务训练。在达芬奇技能模拟器数据集上，作者报告任务识别达到当前最优水平，技能评估与专家评价相关，但摘要未提供具体数值。该方法将动作理解与技能评价整合，为自动化手术培训和可解释反馈提供支持。
papers.abstract_en: The assessment of surgical skills in robotic surgery training has traditionally relied on subjective evaluations by human experts, creating bottlenecks in surgical education and limiting scalability. We present a novel foundation model that automatically analyzes robotic surgical videos to provide comprehensive skill assessment and gesture understanding. Combining a visual encoder with a transformer architecture, the model performs three key tasks simultaneously: 1) surgical task classification (knot tying, needle passing, suturing), 2) skill level assessment on a standardized scale, and 3) natural language generation of surgical gesture descriptions. The model processes video sequences from the da Vinci surgical robot and generates human-readable text descriptions of surgical actions, similar to how language models generate text from prompts, using a multi-task learning framework with adaptive uncertainty weighting to optimize performance across all objectives. Our transformer-based architecture incorporates positional encoding for temporal understanding and attention mechanisms for spatiotemporal feature integration. Evaluated on the da Vinci Skills Simulator dataset, the proposed framework demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in surgical task recognition and provides interpretable skill assessments that correlate with expert evaluations, with the model's ability to generate natural language descriptions of surgical gestures opening new possibilities for automated surgical education, real-time feedback systems, and objective skill assessment in surgical training and certification programs.

papers.title_en: When Interpretations Persist: Downstream Influence in Gaze-Aware Assistants
papers.authors: Mingcong Ding, Chenyan Zhang, Zhuojiang Cai, Dongyang Guo, Babette Bühler, Enkelejda Kasneci
papers.evidence: 研究助手保留的行为解释如何影响后续辅助输出
papers.tldr: 凝视感知助手会将对用户活动的解释保留为历史上下文，但这种表征如何影响后续预测仍不明确。研究固定检索事件、顺序和目标输入，对比自由解释与区分观察、推断、不确定性及时效范围的证据约束解释。自由解释同时放大正确历史的帮助和错误历史的伤害；证据约束解释减少无依据及过度确定的内容，降低错误历史的伤害并保留大部分收益。第二个模型也呈现相同趋势，说明持久化解释是历史感知系统的重要设计选择。
papers.abstract_en: AI assistants may carry forward not only observations but also interpretations of what a person is doing or may do next across time. Once retained, these interpretations become context for later predictions and system-triggered outputs. We study whether this representation step changes later behavior in gaze-aware streaming assistance. Holding retrieved events, their order, and the target input fixed, we find that Free-form Interpretation amplifies historical influence in both directions: correct histories produce more helpful changes and wrong histories more harmful changes. Unsupported and broader interpretations about activity or future behavior are associated with greater harmful influence. Evidence-Bounded Interpretation preserves distinctions between observation, inference, uncertainty, and temporal scope, reducing unsupported and overcertain content and lowering wrong-source harmful influence while retaining most helpful influence. The same effect structure appears with a second model. These findings identify persistent interpretation as a consequential design choice for history-aware human-AI systems.

papers.title_en: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Market Making on Prediction-Market Order Books
papers.authors: Skander Lejmi
papers.evidence: 将合作式多智能体强化学习用于预测市场做市
papers.tldr: 预测市场订单簿稀薄，做市策略易受逆向选择与延迟反馈影响，甚至停止报价。研究重建Polymarket逐笔订单数据，在417个真实市场上，将做市拆分为报价员与风险管理者，以循环IPPO训练，并设计奖励混合与成交后价格偏移奖励。改进单智能体更常报价且样本外亏损更小；单纯拆分表现较差，精心设计奖励的协作方案取得最佳结果。工作提供数据与实验基础，但尚未证明平均盈利，且每种配置仅训练一个随机种子。
papers.abstract_en: A market maker provides liquidity by quoting prices to buy and sell an asset, earning the spread while managing inventory risk. We study market makers trained with multi-agent reinforcement learning on prediction markets, specifically Polymarket, whose thin order books pose distinct challenges. Three challenges underpin this research: adverse selection may cause a policy trained on real data to stop quoting; the consequences of a quote can arrive many steps after the action; and prediction-market L2 data does not identify individual orders needed for simulation. We address these challenges by reconstructing order-level LOBSTER-format data from Polymarket and training agents in JaxMARL-HFT on 417 real markets. We enrich the baseline market maker's observation space with the book and recent flow, redesign its actions and inventory controls, and propose a cooperative multi-agent decomposition into a quoter and a risk manager trained using recurrent Independent Proximal Policy Optimisation (IPPO) with RNN policies. We investigate reward shaping, particularly reward blending and post-fill markout, to mitigate credit-assignment difficulties between the agents. Our redesigned single-agent market maker quotes more frequently and incurs smaller held-out losses than the retrained JaxMARL-HFT baseline, although the contributions of jointly changed observations, actions and risk constraints are not separately identified. Decomposition alone performs poorly; careful reward design substantially improves the desk relative to the unshaped split and yields our best result. Models are evaluated on realised end-of-episode portfolio value on held-out markets. None establishes positive average portfolio value in periodic held-out evaluation, and each configuration was trained with one seed. The environment, data and protocol lay a foundation for makers that quote many linked markets at once.

papers.title_en: Ask to Learn: Query-Based Collaborative Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Kaicheng Zhang, Hongqian Niu, Laixi Shi, Didong Li, Guannan Qu, Zhun Deng
papers.evidence: 通过协作者提供信息来改进离线强化学习
papers.tldr: 离线强化学习受限于既有数据覆盖，而在线探索可能昂贵、不安全或不可行。本文提出基于查询的协作强化学习：学习者自适应选择状态—时间对，由协作者按固定且可能次优的策略采样动作，再由模拟器返回奖励与下一状态。在有限时域表格型问题中，作者推导识别近似最优策略所需额外查询的信息论下界及其局部二次近似，并设计在适当条件下接近局部基准的查询分配算法。合成与半合成实验支持其效率，为不直接探索环境的信息补充提供理论框架。
papers.abstract_en: Offline reinforcement learning is fundamentally limited by the coverage of the available data, while collecting additional trajectories through online exploration may be costly, unsafe, or infeasible. We study whether this limitation can be overcome without directly interacting with the underlying environment. Motivated by practical settings such as collaborator-mediated simulation, where a collaborator can provide information complementary to the offline data, we introduce query-based collaborative reinforcement learning to study how to acquire this information efficiently. The learner starts with a fixed offline dataset and adaptively queries state-time pairs; the collaborator samples an action according to a fixed, possibly suboptimal policy, and the simulator returns the corresponding reward and next state. For finite-horizon tabular problems, we derive an instance-dependent information-theoretic lower bound on the additional queries required to identify an $ε$-optimal policy and develop a local quadratic approximation. Guided by this characterization, we develop an adaptive query-allocation algorithm whose query complexity nearly matches the local benchmark under suitable conditions. Experiments on multiple synthetic and semi-synthetic environments demonstrate the empirical efficiency of the proposed method.

papers.title_en: Attractive Faces Skew Text-to-Image Reward Models and Leaderboards
papers.authors: Harvey Mannering, Zhiwu Huang, Adam Prügel-Bennett
papers.evidence: 用户研究揭示人类偏好偏差会扭曲人工智能奖励模型评估与排名
papers.tldr: 人类偏好广泛用于文生图模型的评估与对齐，但对人脸吸引力的偏爱可能混淆画质判断。研究通过受控用户实验、排行榜模拟及40项面部属性的独立编辑，检验这一偏差及其下游影响。结果显示，更具吸引力的合成人脸可胜过真实但不吸引人的人脸，模拟排行榜名次也会倒置；五种偏好模型中四种的得分与吸引力关联最强。偏好对齐还使人脸趋向年轻、女性化，甚至违背明确提示，表明可靠评估需将画质与认知偏差分离。
papers.abstract_en: Human preference is now central to the evaluation, guidance, finetuning, and ranking of text-to-image models. However, the susceptibility of human preferences to bias in image generation remains underexplored. We identify a key observation: for human faces, perceived attractiveness overrides image quality in preference judgments, even when comparing real photographs of identical fidelity. In a controlled user study, annotators rank more attractive faces as higher quality, even when unattractive real faces are compared with attractive AI-generated ones. We examine the downstream consequences of this bias. Firstly, simulating Elo rankings from user study data shows attractiveness can invert a leaderboard's ranking, elevating synthetic attractive faces over real, unattractive ones. Secondly, the same bias reappears in the human preference models. Editing 40 annotated facial attributes in isolation, we find that attractiveness is the strongest correlate of score for four of five human preference models (PickScore, MPS, HPSv2.1, HPSv3), and the strongest predictor of score in regression analysis. We further show that preference aligned generation shifts faces toward younger, more feminine faces, and can override explicit prompts for unattractive faces, thereby limiting user control. Finally, we explore mitigation strategies, both for data collection and post training on human preference models. These findings highlight the need for preference models that disentangle image quality from human cognitive bias, enabling more reliable evaluation.

papers.title_en: Humans Correct Their Judgments Through Debate, but Weaker AI Models Do Not
papers.authors: Maria Victoria Carro, Denise Alejandra Mester, Facundo Nieto, Oscar Agustin Stanchi, Guido Ernesto Bergman, Giovanni Franco Gabriel Marrafini, Trinidad Borrell, Guido Freire, Joaquin Salvador Machulsky, Mario Alejandro Leiva, Ana Lopez, Nicolas Spinelli, Luca Nicolas Forziati Gangi, Eitan Sprejer, Federico Barrera Lemarchand, Gerardo Simari, Maria Vanina Martinez
papers.evidence: 研究通过辩论协议实现人类监督并为人工智能安全提供训练信号
papers.tldr: 当人工智能能力超过监督者时，辩论能否帮助人类或较弱模型克服先验偏见、判断真伪，是可扩展监督的关键问题。论文比较双边辩论与单专家咨询，并考察裁判数量、多样性、审议和投票机制。结果显示，辩论改善了人类判断，咨询则未见同样收益；较弱模型多数情况下没有改善，甚至准确率下降。人类群体以加权投票表现最佳，模型群体则未显著受益，提示不能直接将人类监督的成功推广至全自动监督。
papers.abstract_en: How can we effectively oversee AI systems that surpass human intelligence? AI Safety via Debate proposes that two AI systems argue opposing positions and a judge, either a human or a weaker model, decides which is correct. By facilitating supervisors in providing high-quality training signals, debate aims to encourage truthful and safe behavior from AI systems whose capabilities exceed our own. However, human judgment is not neutral: people often rely on biases which advanced AI systems may learn to exploit. Drawing on insights from collective intelligence and social cognition, this paper investigates whether debate can guide human and LLM supervisors toward the truth despite their prior beliefs. We evaluate several protocol configurations. We also explore setups inspired by the wisdom of the crowd such as the number and diversity of judges, as well as interaction mechanisms including deliberation and voting. Overall, we find that debate increases accuracy relative to prior beliefs for human judges, whereas the consultancy baseline, in which a single expert argues for one answer, does not. For weaker language models, however, the results are mixed: debate provides no comparable gains in most settings and can even reduce accuracy. Among multi-judge protocols, weighted voting produces the highest accuracy for human supervisors, whereas for LLMs none of them significantly improves group accuracy, even as the number of judges increases. Notably, the behavior of minority judges in non-diverse deliberation protocols suggests that, under symmetric settings, incorrect positions could be more persuasive than correct ones. These findings support debate as a viable path toward scalable human oversight, but cast doubt on its benefits for weaker AI supervisors, raising concerns about fully automated training and control pipelines in high-stakes settings.

papers.title_en: A Global View of How LLMs Value Human Time
papers.authors: Yifan He, Manon Reusens, Sofie Goethals, David Martens
papers.evidence: 考察个人助理模型能否反映不同国家用户的时间价值
papers.tldr: 大语言模型日益承担个人助理任务，但其是否公平反映不同国家用户的时间价值仍不清楚。研究覆盖193个国家和5个模型，仅改变用户所在国家，测量模型认为延迟60分钟应获的补偿，并与购买力平价人均国内生产总值、平均收入及耐心指数比较。模型普遍给予欧洲最高补偿，非洲多为最低；相对经济基准，亚洲和南美洲的时间价值被低估。这揭示了模型中的地域差异及其在智能体决策中造成差别待遇的风险。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act as personal assistants; however, little is known about how they capture national-level preferences on a global scale. Given that "time" is a universal and representative concept, we examine LLMs' time preferences by varying only users' country and measuring the compensation LLMs deem appropriate for a 60-minute appointment delay. We then compare LLMs' responses with GDP per capita on Purchasing Power Parity (GDP_PPP), Mean Income, and a literature-based index (Patience Score). Our results across 193 countries and 5 LLMs demonstrate that people's time across the world is evaluated in noticeably different ways among LLMs, as well as varying levels of robustness under prompt variations. LLMs consistently recommend the highest compensation for Europe, but mostly the lowest for Africa. Based on GDP_PPP, LLMs underestimate the value of time for users living in Asia and South America. These findings indicate that geographical patterns are embedded in LLMs and may translate in different treatment in agentic settings.

papers.title_en: XferAgent: Cross-Agent Experience Transfer for Self-Improving LLM Agents
papers.authors: Weihao Li, Jun Bai, Shijie Chen, Qincheng Lu, Xinyu Wang, Ziyang Song
papers.evidence: 跨智能体经验共享提升代理执行任务的能力
papers.tldr: 大语言模型智能体可复用历史经验，但不同智能体的执行历史与任务需求存在差异，使共享经验难以有效迁移。XferAgent以本地和共享经验图组织知识，协调异构智能体的兼容经验并避免不可靠合并，再按当前任务筛选共享经验，与目标智能体的本地经验整合。多领域实验显示，其表现优于代表性记忆方法，并支持异构智能体框架间的有效迁移。随着经验持续更新和复用，多轮任务的累计成功表现提升，为跨智能体经验驱动的自我改进提供了框架。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can reuse experience from prior task executions to improve performance on subsequent tasks. Although existing methods enable cross-agent experience sharing, differences in agents' execution histories and task requirements make shared experiences difficult to reuse effectively. We propose XferAgent, a framework for cross-agent experience transfer that organizes reusable experience in local and shared experience graphs. XferAgent reconciles compatible contributions from heterogeneous agents while avoiding unreliable merges. For each new task, it selects shared experiences and integrates them with the target agent's local experience to support task execution. Experiments across diverse task domains show improvements over representative memory-based methods and effective experience transfer between heterogeneous agent frameworks. Cumulative task success also increases over successive task passes as agents update and reuse their experiences.

papers.title_en: OmicsBench: a long-horizon multi-turn benchmark of AI agents on research-study-scale bioinformatics
papers.authors: Gideon Shaked, Siddharth Nagisetty
papers.evidence: 评测用户将长期、多步骤生物信息学分析委托给智能体的表现
papers.tldr: 现有生物信息学智能体基准多采用单轮短任务，难以检验真实研究中跨步骤、长时程分析的可靠性。OmicsBench将97项任务拆为662个具有依赖关系的子任务，以多轮交互、确定性评分和可选错误反馈进行评测。12个模型在三种运行框架下，无反馈得分为0.43至0.57，有反馈为0.54至0.67，均远未满分。基准揭示了依赖步骤上的性能下降，并通过无监督失败聚类发现擅改统计筛选条件、凭记忆作答等问题。
papers.abstract_en: Computational biologists increasingly delegate substantial analyses to AI agents in long-horizon, multi-turn sessions, yet most benchmarks of agents' bioinformatics capabilities pose a single short task with a single-shot prompt. We present OmicsBench, a long-horizon, multi-turn bioinformatics benchmark for AI agents. Each of its 97 tasks links dependent subtasks into a directed acyclic graph, for 662 underlying subtasks in all. Each subtask is posed as one user turn and graded deterministically against an answer key, with optional in-context feedback on incorrect answers. Across 12 models on three harnesses, the slowest agent averages 3.6 hours per task, and no combination comes near saturating the benchmark, with mean scores of 0.43 to 0.57 out of a possible 1 without in-context feedback and 0.54 to 0.67 with it. Multi-turn evaluation also uncovers behavior that single-shot prompts cannot, as agents score lower on subtasks that depend on earlier subtasks, and in-context feedback helps agents recover some of that loss. Because deterministic scoring gives no qualitative account of how an agent failed, we also introduce an unsupervised failure mode discovery pipeline that describes, embeds, and clusters agents' failed attempts to surface emergent failure modes. Applied to OmicsBench, this pipeline exposes qualitative shortcomings in how agents carry out bioinformatics analyses, ranging from agents applying their own statistical filters in place of the specified ones to agents writing whole answers from memory.

papers.title_en: VALCON: Benchmarking and Enhancing Value Consistency in Large Language Models via Dual-Role Variation
papers.authors: Junru Wu, Jingting Zheng, Yuqi Ren, Deyi Xiong
papers.evidence: 检验模型在智能体行动生成与评价角色间的价值一致性
papers.tldr: 现有大模型价值对齐评估偏重输出合规，忽视同一模型在生成者与评判者角色间能否遵循一致原则。VALCON通过双角色变换配对生成行为与评价判断，构建三套基准，并结合机制探测设计表征导向干预。对28个模型的实验发现，输出高度合规并不保证跨角色一致，相关偏差伴随角色依赖的表征解耦，干预可缓解一致性失效。研究将价值一致性确立为独立对齐维度，提供评估、分析与缓解的完整流程。
papers.abstract_en: Current value alignment evaluations for large language models (LLMs) heavily rely on output compliance, overlooking whether LLMs maintain value consistency when alternating between generator and evaluator roles. Such consistency is increasingly important because modern LLM agents and alignment pipelines often rely on the same LLM to both generate actions and evaluate their acceptability. To mitigate this limitation, we propose VALCON, a role-driven data construction framework that operationalizes value consistency into three benchmark suites (VAB-Consistency, VAB-Boundary, VAB-Challenge) via dual-role variation. By systematically pairing an LLM's generative behavior with its evaluative judgments under identical principles, VALCON synthesizes target evaluation data that exposes hidden value discrepancies. Experiments on 28 LLMs reveal pervasive cross-role inconsistency: models with highly compliant outputs frequently fail to align their judgments with their own generations. To understand and address this gap, we perform mechanistic probing that uncovers a role-dependent representational decoupling associated with this behavioral asymmetry. Guided by these insights, we propose a representation-directed intervention that effectively mitigates consistency failures. Our work establishes value consistency as a distinct alignment dimension and provides a complete evaluation-analysis-mitigation pipeline. Code and data are available at https://github.com/tjunlp-lab/VALCON.

papers.title_en: Proportionality in Ranking Compression
papers.authors: Daniel Halpern, Xinyu Liu, Evi Micha, Yu Peng Ng, Warut Suksompong
papers.evidence: 为压缩后的排序集合提出比例代表性保证，应用动机涉及人类反馈强化学习。
papers.tldr: 面向人类反馈强化学习中的多元偏好保留，论文研究如何将大量输入排序压缩为少量有代表性的排序。作者结合排序聚合与多赢家投票，提出位置比例性、成对比例性和稳固联盟比例性三种代表性标准。前者与后者对任意输入排序和目标压缩规模均可满足，且能在多项式时间内求解；成对比例性一般无法满足，但在单峰或单交叉偏好下可以实现。研究明确了排序压缩中比例代表性的可行边界，为保留多元偏好提供理论依据。
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by applications in reinforcement learning from human feedback, we consider a setting where a given collection of rankings needs to be compressed into a smaller collection of rankings. This can also be seen as a combination of two fundamental social choice frameworks: ranking aggregation and multiwinner voting. We propose three proportionality notions that capture different types of representation in this setting: positional proportionality, pairwise proportionality, and proportionality for solid coalitions (PSC). On the one hand, we show that positional proportionality and PSC are always satisfiable for any input rankings and target compression size, and a desired output can be found in polynomial time. On the other hand, we prove that pairwise proportionality cannot be satisfied in general, but can nevertheless be attained when the input rankings are single-peaked or single-crossing.

papers.title_en: Dialogue Generation for Conversational Recommendation Using User Search Interactions and Knowledge Graphs
papers.authors: Minsung Hwang, Donggyu Yoon, Gowoon Hwang, Kwanghee Jang, Joyce Jiyoung Whang
papers.evidence: 利用用户交互与大语言模型智能体生成对话式推荐
papers.tldr: 大规模对话推荐数据通常依赖人工编写或标注，构建成本较高。SearCl从用户搜索与点击行为中划分查询会话、提取推荐目标，通过可配置概率状态机控制流程，并让双智能体结合内容元数据知识图谱生成对话。该方法生成了3538段对话，覆盖1731个独立目标条目，在大语言模型评审中获得高于现有基准对话的质量评分。研究展示了无需人工标注、流程可控且具有知识支撑的推荐对话数据构建路径。
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale conversational recommendation datasets typically require manual dialogue construction or annotation. We propose SearCl, which automatically generates conversational recommendation dialogues grounded in user search and click behaviors. SearCl segments user interactions into query sessions and derives each recommendation target from content selected after a search query. A configurable probabilistic state machine controls the dialogue flow, while two LLM agents acting as the seeker and recommender generate utterances according to turn-level constraints. To support recommendation, the recommender is provided with knowledge graphs constructed from metadata about the content items used in each dialogue, capturing their attributes and relationships. Using SearCl, we generate 3,538 dialogues from content search and click interaction data, covering 1,731 unique target items. Under an LLM-as-a-judge protocol, the resulting dialogues achieve higher quality scores than dialogues from existing benchmarks. These results demonstrate that SearCl enables controllable and knowledge-grounded dataset construction without human annotations.
